## Objective

Deliver canonical relationship exploration with stable bounded interaction and complete textual equivalence.

## Scope

- Implement normalized relationship data and independent List
- Implement focused graph renderer and controls
- Integrate truthful loading and failure recovery

## Entry conditions

- Phase 3 reader and route state are available; implement normalized List before renderer and test actual Map/List parity after integration.

## Exit criteria

- Select/focus/expand, semantic edge identity, Map/List and resilient narrow-screen behavior pass.

## Risks

- Layout must never imply chronology/causality or erase relations and qualifiers.

## TASK-017 - Implement normalized relationship data and independent List

Build one normalized relationship model and semantic List over bounded reader data, preserving exact selection, filters, returned scope, identity/direction/qualifier/evidence and focus/more-connection intentions independently of the graph library.

| Dependencies | TASK-006, TASK-015, TASK-012 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- None

### Acceptance criteria

- The normalized model retains all returned node/relation IDs, canonical endpoints/predicates/direction, qualifiers, sources, warnings, filters and limits without inferring completeness.
- List entry/evidence/focus/expand actions work using keyboard and the shared read/state layer with the renderer module absent; no canvas/drag/hover/double-click is required.
- Selection and returned scope survive switching intentions; actual Map/List parity is a required integration gate in TASK-019 after the renderer is connected.

### Planned verification

- Compare List and normalized API records against exact fixture identities, direction, qualifiers, sources and coverage; complete neighbor/source/focus/more/return using keyboard with the renderer unavailable.
- Verify List has no renderer import dependency and exposes meaningful result/selection announcements without hundreds of hidden controls. AT-16 and AT-29 actual Map/List switching is verified by TASK-019.

## TASK-018 - Implement focused graph renderer and controls

Implement the renderer adapter and bounded stable 2D map with distinct select/focus/expand, canonical IDs, directed labeled edges, qualifier inspection, pan/zoom/Fit/Reset and failure fallback.

| Status | `planned` |

| Dependencies | TASK-006, TASK-012, TASK-017 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- None

### Acceptance criteria

- Initial Map uses a selected ID or reviewed picker and one-step bounded data; selecting updates details without camera/focus change.
- Focus here deliberately replaces neighborhood; expansion preserves existing positions where practical, stops bounded layout and respects cumulative 100-node/200-edge proposed ceiling and tighter service limits.
- Parallel IDs, self-loops, cycles, conditional qualifiers, direction and selected/adjacent labels remain faithful; no continuous hidden simulation or unsupported semantic position claim.
- Renderer reads the normalized model and emits intentions; it never initiates source/ontology reads. Legend and guidance retain: Select a term to read it. Use Focus here to explore its connections.

### Planned verification

- Run AT-10, AT-11, AT-12, AT-13, AT-14, AT-15 on actual production renderer, high-degree fixture and timeout fallback.
- Measure that selection does not recreate graph, leaving Map disposes instances/listeners/timers/observers, and reduced motion stops animation.

## TASK-019 - Integrate truthful loading and failure recovery

Integrate region-scoped loading/errors, session/service recovery, coherent Refresh knowledge, response sequence checks, renderer fallback and responsive theme/reflow behavior.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | `planned` |
| State reason | None |

| Dependencies | TASK-014, TASK-015, TASK-012, TASK-016, TASK-018, TASK-017 |
| Parallel group | None |
| Completed at | None |

### Risks

- None

### Acceptance criteria

- AT-21, AT-22, AT-23, AT-34 preserve useful context, reject stale responses and mixed snapshots, discard incompatible expansions/cursors on refresh and keep List/evidence usable if renderer fails.
- When no relationships are recorded in the returned view, say No relationships are recorded in this view; byte/time/traversal limits and incomplete data are distinguished from absence.
- 320 CSS-pixel layouts, substantial zoom, both themes and reduced motion preserve controls, reading, narrow drawers and vertically flowing process/source text.
- Back/Forward restores useful reading/map context; deliberate node selection pushes one history item while camera movements do not spam history.
- Terms/Map switching preserves exact identity; credentials are absent from safe routes and copied links; normal new-tab entry links work after authentication where practical.
- Theme light/dark/system and reset affect presentation only; source bodies and knowledge are not persisted to browser databases/storage.
- AT-16 and AT-29 compare exact Map/List relation IDs, direction, qualifiers, sources, warnings, filters, selection and returned scope. Every substantive map action remains usable through List when graph import or rendering fails.

### Planned verification

- Inject out-of-order fetches, session expiry, server stop, invalid config, renderer exception, layout timeout and mid-navigation publication.
- Observe focus restoration/announcements, 320px reflow, zoom and dark/light contrast on production assets.
- Test route round-trips, back/forward, malformed ID, old project context, safe post-auth restoration and AT-22 response races.
- Inspect browser storage after sources/maps and reset; only documented harmless project-specific preferences and necessary transient session handling remain.
- Run real Map/List switching and keyboard-only neighbor/source/focus/more/return flows, including absent renderer module, layout timeout and truncated data; compare both views against the same normalized response.
